t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Gnomes come in different sets of pairs, each providing different points, it is better to practice while the points are on 1x to learn when to take the maximum risks when 5x is on.

vb_textbox.text:
Each round has a different set of gnomes, different sizes, they will change each time, the aim is to figure which gnome of each pair is the highest paying, the best way to achieve this is with trial and error during the 1x rounds, use these rounds to test what is higher paying, taking bigger risks here to experiment.
Once you have a good idea of which pays higher you can then use this to get the maximum on the 5x.
